title: Coverage counts payslips as missing during unpaid parental leave
found: PAY-A is a fortnightly stream. During unpaid leave nothing is issued, and coverage names those fortnights as missing, so a low month reads as a missing month.
want: A person can pause a stream for a dated period. A run of `stream` rows with valid_to already does this, so the runtime may be able to land it without the base.
owner: runtime first, data model session if it cannot
